sql: select 'resting_live_orders' as k, count(*)::text as v from live_orders where status in ('resting','pending','open') union all select 'live_orders_24h', count(*)::text from live_orders where created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' union all select 'latest_position_snapshot', coalesce(max(captured_at)::text,'none') from positions union all select 'nonzero_positions_latest', count(*)::text from (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, quantity from positions order by market_ticker, captured_at desc) p where coalesce(p.quantity,0) <> 0
